versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "paywalls" skill focused on optimizing in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, and feature gates.
- Provides proven frameworks and best practices for converting free users to paid at key product moments.
- Includes detailed guidelines for timing, paywall design, copywriting, and user journey considerations.
- Summarizes anti-patterns to avoid and offers actionable checklists and question prompts.
- Outlines A/B testing ideas and core metrics for ongoing paywall optimization.
- Clearly distinguishes in-product paywalls from public pricing pages (handled by the CRO skill).
